details: lambfetchx548811 0.0.1 (2026-05-12). Its .yardopts uses --load to run evil.rb when YARD builds the gem's documentation, which gave the publisher code execution on RubyDoc.info's documentation build workers. RubyGems.org's CDN could cache the response of /api/v1/api_key and hand another account's API key to an unauthenticated request (RubyGems.org advisory of 2026-07-22). The script fetches a council web page from the worker, requests /api/v1/api_key.yaml, takes whatever RubyGems key comes back, and uses it to publish the fetched page as version 0.0.2. The rubyhack.ai research lists it among the packages that attempted this key leak. Documented in the rubyhack.ai research by Spencer Kitts, Thomas Larsen and Sydney Von Arx (2026-09-11). The gem has been removed from RubyGems.
